summary: Frontend-only verification of P1 (shared theme constants in /app/frontend/src/lib/plan-theme.js) + P2 (downloadable JPEG/PDF + share toolbar on /compensation-plan). All 12 requested acceptance checks passed. No regressions on Landing page 8-level plan section.
critical_code_review_comments: plan-theme.js is a clean single-source-of-truth module. INCOME_LEVELS totals verified against calculations (6^n * per) and match infographic (L8 total = 1,679,616 * 100 = 167,961,600; sum L1..L8 = 203,699,600).
Consider adding a small unit assertion in dev mode (or a lightweight vitest) to catch future drift between LEVEL_COLORS keys and INCOME_LEVELS length (currently manually coupled).

downloadPdf handler uses canvas.toDataURL on a cross-origin image with img.crossOrigin='anonymous' — works only when the origin sends proper CORS headers. Verified live: PDF (350KB) generated successfully, so the emergentagent CDN allows anonymous CORS. If the URL is ever swapped to a non-CORS host, this will silently fail with 'Couldn't build PDF' toast.
downloadJpeg does not check res.ok before res.blob() — if the CDN returns HTML error the browser would still download it as .jpg. Minor robustness improvement (add `if(!res.ok) throw`).
copyLink uses execCommand fallback correctly — verified toast 'Plan link copied' appears in headless Chromium.
context_for_next_testing_agent: All P1/P2 acceptance criteria verified live on https://hamper-mlm-hub.preview.emergentagent.com. Verified: (1) compensation-plan-page loads; (2) plan-infographic img loads with naturalWidth=1024; (3) plan-share-toolbar with 4 buttons present; (4) 3 KPI stat cards show ₹7,200 / 6 / 3; (5) 8-row plan-table with L8 total color rgb(251,191,36) amber; (6) plan-disclaimer contains 'Twenty Crore Thirty Six Lakh Ninety Nine Thousand Six Hundred'; (7) download-jpeg-btn triggers download 'EverGro-eMart-8-Level-Plan.jpg' (277KB); (8) download-pdf-btn triggers download 'EverGro-eMart-8-Level-Plan.pdf' (350KB) starting with %PDF- magic bytes; (9) share-whatsapp-btn opens https://wa.me/?text=... with 'EverGro eMart', '₹7,200', '₹20,36,99,600' in decoded text (initial test showed FAIL due to WhatsApp server-side redirect to api.whatsapp.com and urllib unquote-vs-unquote_plus test bug — retested by intercepting window.open and passed); (10) copy-link-btn shows 'Plan link copied' toast; (11) Landing plan-income-table still renders 8 rows with correct values and L8 amber color — no regression from switching to INCOME_LEVELS import; (12) total-potential text on Landing includes both '₹20,36,99,600' and the words 'Twenty Crore Thirty Six Lakh Ninety Nine Thousand Six Hundred'. jspdf@^4.2.1 installed and dynamically imported inside downloadPdf.
